Drain and refill capacity:
2.4 liters (2.5 US qts, 2.1 Imp. qts)

Dry fill capacity:
6.5 liters (6.9 US qts, 5.7 Imp. qts)

items: (d) Start the engine and shift the selector into all positions from "P" through "L", and then shift into "P".
(e) With the engine idling, check the fluid level. Add fluid up to the "COOL" level on the dipstick.
